name: Danshi Koukou Yakyuuken
source:
Story?
The main character, Eiji Saito, who has awakened to this road before he knew it, With the help of his bad friend Fukuhara, he grasps the weakness of a boy who has a secret. Fight the wrong passion battle for that gem of skin! !


Overview?
So, it is a baseball fist game that proceeds in a character selection and conversational format. Is it love by conversation? If you do, you can worship more than naked.
By the way, the main character does not take off except for a specific character. That's why it's a main character attack in general, so be careful.
Also, after all, it is 18 bans.
